businesses.description: Ivanhoe Ale Works is a locally owned craft brewery and taproom located in the restored Star & State Theater in historic downtown Denison. Known as Texas' first 'brewinery,' it shares its historic venue with Homestead Winery, offering both craft beer and wine under one roof. Ivanhoe Ale Works regularly hosts live music, trivia, tabletop gaming, educational programs, community gatherings, seasonal celebrations, and other public events, making it one of the premier entertainment venues in downtown Denison.
businesses.hours_note: Hours may vary during special events and festivals.

businesses.description: Austin College is a private, four-year liberal arts and sciences college in Sherman with a campus that also serves as one of the area's most active educational, cultural, athletic and community-event destinations. In addition to its academic programs, the college hosts public lectures, leadership programs, theatre productions, concerts, art exhibitions, athletic competitions, academic conferences, camps, ceremonies and signature events throughout the year.
businesses.why_visit: Visit Austin College for public lectures, concerts, theatre productions, art exhibitions, NCAA Division III athletics, academic conferences, campus tours, youth programs and major community-facing events. The more than 100-acre campus includes historic landmarks, green spaces, galleries, performance facilities, athletic venues and modern academic buildings.
businesses.why_its_unique: Austin College combines the resources of a nationally recognized liberal arts institution with an unusually active calendar of cultural, educational, athletic and civic programming. Its Sherman campus brings together student research, visiting speakers, performing arts, visual arts, leadership events, competitive athletics and community programs in one setting.
businesses.hours_note: Campus offices, facilities, galleries, performances, athletic events and public programs operate on separate schedules. Check the official website, event calendar or individual department before visiting.

Athletic events, performances and conferences may use different campus entrances and parking areas.
Use the official campus map when attending an event in an unfamiliar building.
Campus tours should be arranged through the Admission Office.
The campus bookstore generally operates weekday business hours and is closed on weekends.
Dining facilities primarily serve the campus community, and public availability may vary.
Campus Police and Safety operates 24 hours a day.

businesses.description: 34 Chophouse & Doc's Lounge is a modern steakhouse and cocktail lounge in historic downtown Denison. Inspired by Denison-born President Dwight D. Eisenhower, the 34th president of the United States, the restaurant offers steakhouse dining, seafood, cocktails, bourbon, happy hour, live music and private-event options. Dinner is served in the main dining room, while Doc's Lounge offers a more casual bar and lounge experience.
businesses.why_visit: Visit for an upscale downtown Denison dinner, steakhouse favorites, seafood, handcrafted cocktails, an extensive bourbon selection, happy hour and scheduled live music in Doc's Lounge. Reservations are available for dining, while lounge seating provides a more casual option.
businesses.why_its_unique: The concept connects two notable figures associated with Denison history: Dwight D. Eisenhower, the 34th president, and Doc Holliday. It combines a modern steakhouse, cocktail lounge, live-music schedule and private-event space in one historic downtown location.
businesses.hours_note: These are Doc's Lounge and overall opening hours. Dinner-room hours are Monday through Thursday 5:00 PM to 9:00 PM, Friday and Saturday 4:00 PM to 10:00 PM, and Sunday 4:00 PM to 8:00 PM. Happy hour is Sunday through Friday from 4:00 PM to 6:00 PM. Holiday and special-event hours may vary.
good_to_know: The dining room and Doc's Lounge follow different operating hours.

The official schedule lists live music Thursday from 6:00 PM to 8:00 PM and Friday and Saturday from 6:30 PM to 9:30 PM.
Private-event space is available for both smaller gatherings and larger parties.
Contact the venue directly to confirm performers, private-event capacity, holiday hours and special-event schedules.

businesses.description: WinStar World Casino & Resort is a major casino resort and entertainment destination in Thackerville, Oklahoma, just north of the Texas-Oklahoma border. businesses.description: Lake Texoma is a major reservoir spanning the Texas-Oklahoma border and one of the region's leading outdoor recreation and vacation destinations. The lake offers approximately 89,000 surface acres for fishing, boating, sailing, kayaking, paddleboarding, swimming and other water recreation. Surrounding destinations include public parks, state parks, campgrounds, marinas, resorts, boat rentals, fishing guides, hiking and equestrian trails, wildlife refuges, restaurants, lodging and communities on both sides of the lake. This Texoma Weekend Guide hub brings together Lake Texoma attractions, businesses, access points and upcoming events in one searchable regional resource.
businesses.why_visit: Visit Lake Texoma for fishing, boating, beaches, camping, hiking, wildlife watching, waterfront dining and year-round getaways. Visitors can plan anything from a quiet day at a public park to a full vacation involving a resort, marina, fishing charter, boat rental and events around the lake.
businesses.why_its_unique: Lake Texoma crosses the Texas-Oklahoma border and supports an unusually broad mix of recreation, tourism and wildlife experiences. It is widely known for striped-bass fishing and is one of the relatively few reservoirs where striped bass reproduce naturally. Its irregular shoreline connects dozens of parks, marinas, resorts, communities and attractions across two states.
businesses.hours_note: Lake Texoma does not have one universal set of operating hours. Access hours, seasonal schedules, admission fees and closures vary by park, marina, boat ramp, campground, resort and attraction. Check the individual destination before making a dedicated trip.
amenities: More than 1,000 campsites around the lake
U.S. Army Corps of Engineers parks
good_to_know: Lake Texoma spans both Texas and Oklahoma, so regulations and licensing requirements can vary according to location and activity.
Anglers may use the appropriate Texas or Oklahoma fishing license for that state's waters or purchase a Lake Texoma fishing license that covers both sides of the lake.
Access fees, parking fees, camping rates and reservation requirements vary by individual park, marina, resort and recreation area.
Boat-ramp availability can change with lake levels, construction, weather and seasonal conditions.
Zebra mussels are present in Lake Texoma. Boaters should clean, drain and dry boats, trailers, livewells, bait containers and other equipment before entering another body of water.
Not every shoreline area offers public access. Use established parks, ramps, marinas and designated recreation areas.
Swimming areas may not have lifeguards. Review local safety rules and current conditions before entering the water.
Pet rules differ by property. Dogs generally must remain leashed outside designated off-leash areas.
The Texoma Weekend Guide Lake Texoma hub is intended to include businesses, attractions and events located within approximately 10 miles of the shoreline.
Individual destination pages should be treated as the source for current hours, fees, reservations, amenities and access conditions.

businesses.description: La Mesa Mexican Restaurante & Cantina is a family-owned Sherman restaurant that has served the community since 1985. Located on Texoma Parkway, La Mesa offers a broad menu of classic Tex-Mex favorites, including fajitas, enchiladas, tacos, burritos, chimichangas, quesadillas, combination dinners, salads, American selections, children's meals, desserts, and lunch specials. The restaurant is especially known for generous portions, signature margaritas, house hot sauce, queso, fajitas, and longtime local recognition.
businesses.why_visit: Visit La Mesa for a familiar, casual Tex-Mex meal with a large menu that works well for families, groups, lunch outings, and diners who want plenty of choices. Guests can order classic combination plates, sizzling fajitas, enchiladas, brisket dishes, vegetarian selections, children's meals, margaritas, and other cantina drinks, with pickup and delivery also available.
businesses.why_its_unique: La Mesa has been part of the Sherman dining landscape since 1985, giving it more than four decades of local history. Its official Facebook page states that it has been recognized as Texoma's Best Mexican Restaurant since 2003 and has also received recognition for its salsa and fajitas. Its combination of longevity, family ownership, expansive menu, generous portions, house hot sauce, and signature margaritas distinguishes it from newer chain-style Tex-Mex options.

businesses.description: Casa Romo Cocina Mexicana is a family-owned and operated Mexican restaurant in historic downtown Ardmore. Founded by Jose and Socorro Romo in May 2002, the full-service restaurant serves Mexican and Tex-Mex dishes, unique house specialties, a weekday and Saturday lunch buffet, lunch specials, desserts and a broad drink selection. Guests can dine in, order carryout, order online or request DoorDash delivery. Casa Romo also provides catering for weddings, business functions, celebrations and other gatherings.

businesses.description: The Painted Easel is a Gordonville-based art and event business offering guided paint parties, painting lessons, seasonal craft projects, private gatherings and youth art activities throughout the Texoma region. The business partners with restaurants, wineries, community organizations and other host venues to provide social, step-by-step creative experiences. Projects have included canvas and board paintings, porch leaners, door hangers, doormats, garden flags and other decorative crafts, with designs often tailored to seasons, holidays and the host location.
businesses.why_visit: Choose The Painted Easel for a relaxed, social creative activity where participants can complete their own artwork with guided instruction. Events are designed to welcome beginners and are suitable for friends, couples, families, private groups and people looking for something different to do around Texoma. Most public paint parties include the project materials and instruction, while restaurant-hosted events allow guests to purchase food and drinks from the venue.
businesses.why_its_unique: Rather than operating only from one traditional storefront, The Painted Easel takes creative experiences directly to restaurants, wineries, lake communities, private groups and other venues across Texoma. Its broad project selection extends beyond standard canvas painting to decorative boards, doormats, garden flags, porch leaners and seasonal crafts. This mobile model allows each event to reflect the audience, location and occasion.

businesses.description: Texoma Health Foundation Park is a 66-acre public recreation, athletics and community-event complex located within Gateway Village in Denison. The park includes baseball and softball fields, soccer and multi-use fields, lighted sand-volleyball courts, an ADA-accessible playground, a seasonal splash pad, paved multi-use trails, outdoor exercise equipment, a reservable pavilion, restrooms, concessions and extensive open green space.
businesses.why_visit: Visit for family recreation, youth and adult sports, walking, outdoor exercise, playground time, seasonal splash-pad fun and community events. Its variety of facilities makes it useful for everything from a quick park visit to tournaments, races, festivals and organized group activities.
businesses.why_its_unique: The park combines a large-scale sports complex, inclusive playground and splash-pad amenities, a certified 5K route, outdoor fitness features and flexible community-event space within one 66-acre destination at Gateway Village.
businesses.hours_note: Normal park hours are daily from 5:00 AM to 11:00 PM. City-sanctioned events and properly permitted activities may continue beyond normal closing time. The splash pad operates seasonally from May 1 through September 30, daily from 10:00 AM to 8:00 PM. Holiday, maintenance and event-related schedules may vary.
good_to_know: The Facebook place titled Texoma Health Foundation Park Splashpad describes the overall park; the splash pad is one amenity within Texoma Health Foundation Park.
The splash pad is free and normally operates May 1 through September 30 from 10:00 AM to 8:00 PM daily.
No reservation is required to use the splash pad.
The pavilion is located beside the playground and splash pad and may be reserved through Denison Parks and Recreation.
Pavilion rentals are offered in four-hour blocks from 7:00 AM to 11:00 AM, noon to 4:00 PM and 5:00 PM to 9:00 PM.
The currently published pavilion rental fee is $200 per four-hour block.
The playground and splash pad remain open to the public during pavilion rentals.
Onsite grilling is not permitted at the pavilion.
Call Denison Parks and Recreation at 903-465-2720 for general information and pavilion reservations.
For after-hours park issues, call 903-647-0507.
Sports fields, facilities and event areas may have separate reservation, league or tournament requirements.

City splash-pad information was used for the seasonal operating schedule. businesses.description: Abby's Restaurant is a family-owned restaurant in downtown Howe serving home-cooked American comfort food in a welcoming, casual setting. businesses.why_visit: Visit Abby's Restaurant for generous portions of familiar home-style food, friendly local service and a menu with options for the entire family. It is a convenient choice for lunch during the week, with extended dinner hours on Thursday and Friday.
businesses.why_its_unique: Abby's combines a small-town, family-owned atmosphere with a broad comfort-food menu built around home-cooked favorites. Its downtown Howe location and strong local following make it a community go-to rather than a chain dining experience.
businesses.hours_note: Published hours are Monday through Wednesday from 11:00 AM to 2:00 PM and Thursday and Friday from 11:00 AM to 8:00 PM. Closed Saturday and Sunday. Holiday hours and temporary schedule changes may vary; confirm through the official Facebook page or by phone.
good_to_know: Abby's Restaurant is located in downtown Howe at 110 E Haning Street.
The restaurant is open for lunch Monday through Friday, with extended dinner hours Thursday and Friday.
Online ordering is available through Peppr.
The menu includes chicken-fried steak, chicken-fried chicken, catfish, burgers, steaks, sandwiches, wraps, salads, soups, loaded baked potatoes, appetizers, kids meals and desserts.

businesses.description: Grandpappy Point Resort & Marina is a full-service Lake Texoma resort and marina located on more than 180 waterfront acres in Denison. The destination includes more than 700 boat slips, over 30 boathouses, cabin rentals, RV and tent camping, boat storage, a boat ramp, fuel service, marine maintenance, yacht sales, recreation facilities, reservable gathering spaces and access to waterfront dining at The Point Restaurant.
businesses.why_visit: Visit for a complete Lake Texoma getaway with boating, fishing, sailing, cabin stays, camping, waterfront recreation and convenient marina services in one destination. Grandpappy Point accommodates day visitors, overnight guests, boat owners, fishing groups, families and private gatherings.
businesses.why_its_unique: Grandpappy Point combines one of Lake Texoma's largest full-service marinas with cabins, camping, marine services, recreation, dining and event spaces across a large waterfront property. Its range of lodging, boating and gathering options makes it a destination rather than simply a place to launch or store a boat.
businesses.hours_note: Hours vary by department, season and service. Cabin reservations, marina-office service, fuel-dock operations, boat service, camping and dining may follow separate schedules. The fuel dock currently publishes Friday through Sunday hours from 9:00 AM to 6:00 PM, with Tuesday through Thursday service available by calling the marina office and Monday closed. Contact the resort directly before visiting for a specific service.
good_to_know: Grandpappy Point occupies more than 180 acres along Lake Texoma.
The marina includes more than 700 slips and over 30 boathouses.
More than 20 cabins are available, ranging from single-room accommodations for two guests to a six-bedroom group cabin sleeping up to 18.
Cabins include either kitchenettes or full kitchens, Wi-Fi, televisions, linens and basic kitchen supplies.
Pets are allowed in designated cabins for an additional fee.
All cabins are nonsmoking.
The Point Restaurant is a separate waterfront restaurant located within the marina and should eventually have its own linked directory record.
The Cedar Lounge is a private-event space accommodating up to approximately 50 guests.
The Cedar Lounge includes a full kitchen, dining areas, a wraparound bar, multiple televisions and a large projector screen.
Catering for Cedar Lounge events may be available through The Point Restaurant.
Fuel-dock, restaurant, marina-office and other service hours vary independently.
Contact the resort directly for current cabin availability, campsite reservations, slip availability, rates and seasonal schedules.

businesses.description: Established in 1987, Vitina's Deli & Boiler Room is a locally owned sandwich shop, deli, and coffee bar in downtown Sherman. businesses.why_its_unique: Vitina's has served Sherman since 1987 and combines a traditional neighborhood deli with made-to-order breakfast, fresh-baked bread, homemade desserts, specialty coffee, and a distinctive historic downtown setting.
